title: TAPESTRY: A Single Backbone for Video Generation and Robot Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.36823v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained video generation models encode rich priors about physical interactions, but leveraging them for robot control typically requires either resource-intensive video generation at test time or action heads trained from scratch that do not fully utilize the pretrained backbone. We introduce Tokenizing Actions as Video Patches in a Shared Transformer Policy (TAPESTRY), a world action model that repurposes a pretrained video diffusion transformer into a robotic policy without requiring video generation at inference. Our key idea is to treat robot actions as single-patch tokens in the video model's latent space. A lightweight linear projection maps each action timestep to the patch dimensions of the pretrained VAE, and the resulting tokens are processed by the same patchifying layers and transformer backbone used for video. The shared backbone is optimized through three diffusion objectives sampled per minibatch element: Video diffus

translated_title: TAPESTRY：视频生成与机器人控制的单一骨干网络
translated_abstract: 预训练视频生成模型编码了关于物理交互的丰富先验知识，但将其应用于机器人控制通常需要在测试时进行资源密集型的视频生成，或者需要从头训练且未能充分利用预训练骨干网络的动作头。我们提出TAPESTRY（在共享Transformer策略中将动作标记为视频补丁），这是一种世界动作模型，它将预训练的视频扩散Transformer改造为机器人策略，而无需在推理时进行视频生成。我们的核心思想是将机器人动作视为视频模型潜在空间中的单补丁标记。一个轻量级的线性投影将每个动作时间步映射到预训练VAE的补丁维度，所得标记由与视频相同的补丁化层和Transformer骨干网络处理。共享骨干网络通过三个扩散目标进行优化，每个小批量元素采样一个目标（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: TAPESTRY通过将机器人动作作为单补丁标记嵌入视频模型的潜在空间，用一个轻量级线性投影将动作映射到预训练VAE维度，使同一预训练视频扩散Transformer骨干网络既能用于视频生成又能直接作为机器人控制策略，且推理时无需生成视频。
en_tdlr: TAPESTRY repurposes a pretrained video diffusion transformer into a robotic policy by tokenizing robot actions as single-patch tokens in the video model's latent space via lightweight linear projections, enabling a single shared backbone for both video generation and robot control without video generation at inference.
